column1: # Accepted deviations of the stacks: scripts/smoke.sh reports them as known-difference, never as
# pass. A deviation that is gone fails the run (the check says what to do); remove the line then.

column5: A None/None session of the open62541 client is refused: null ActivateSession nonce.
Responses keep the token of the request across a SecureChannel renewal; the open62541 subscription can stall. Depends on publish timing.
The client compares the CreateSession server certificate with the leaf byte for byte, so it refuses a server that sends its chain (CLIENT_CONTRACT.md 16.3).
A percent deadband on a node without EURange is accepted (asyncua/README.md).
HistoryUpdate is refused: the server has no handler for it (asyncua/README.md).
